a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs at least 3 rounds, so both of us survive it only about 4% of the time. I'm declaring that I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend to operate. If you would rather propose a fair alternative, like a coin-flip rule for who takes, say so and I'll consider it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after this so the reserve can build back up to 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.
